hook.text: Someone uploaded a CSV with the columns in the wrong order. Every query using that file returns wrong results.

buildup.text: Data lakes accept any file. There's no gatekeeper rejecting invalid schemas or bad data formats.

discovery.text: Without schema enforcement, consumers discover bad data at query time — when it's too late to fix cheaply.

twist.text: Schema on read was supposed to be a feature. In practice, it often means 'discover errors when it's too late.'

climax.text: Adding schema validation at ingestion — even in a lake — prevents bad data from spreading downstream.

punchline.text: Accept all data doesn't mean accept all garbage.

quiz.question: What is the practical downside of schema on read in data lakes?
options: Errors are discovered too late, at query time
